text: The ADB–MoF–NDRC Initiative for Parametric Flood Insurance is a collaborative effort aimed at exploring and designing a parametric flood insurance facility for the Yangtze River basin in China. This initiative seeks to provide rapid financial liquidity following flood events, using pre-agreed triggers based on hazard intensity to ensure fast payouts. It aligns with China's 14th Five-Year Plan and ADB's country partnership strategy, focusing on disaster risk financing and integrated flood risk management.
